verses.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੜੇ ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬਾਰਹੀ ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਹੀ ਬਾਵੰਜਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: kitaRe khatree baarahee ketaRiaa(n) hee baava(n)jaahee|

en.bdb: Many khatris (Khatris in Punjab) belong to twelve and many to fifty-two clans.
Many among them are called Pavadhe, Pachadhia, Phalian, Khokharain.
Many are Chaurotari and many Serin have passed away.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਤੜਿਆਂ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਹੋਇ ਚਕ੍ਰਵਰਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਦਰਗਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: ketaRiaa(n) avataar hoi chakravarat raaje dharagaahee|

en.bdb: Many were universal kings in the forms of incarnation (of God).
Many are known as belonging to sun and moon dynasties.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਧਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ਨ ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: dharam rai dharamaatamaa dharam veechaar na beparavaahee|

en.bdb: Many religious persons like the god of dharma and thinkers on dharma and then many caring for none have been.
The real khatri is the one who gives charitably, wears arms and remembers God with loving devotion.
